item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 21/May/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A trough of low pressure will continue to bring heavy showers and squally thunderstorms to the northern part of the South China Sea and the coast of southern China today. Meanwhile, an easterly airstream will affect the coast of southeastern China. The trough of low pressure will weaken slightly in the following couple of days but there will still be a few showers over the coastal areas of Guangdong. Under the influence of upper-air disturbances, the weather will be unsettled over southern China towards the weekend. With the upper-air disturbances departing, showers will ease off over the coast of Guangdong during the weekend.
